guard.refuse_dropped_advice: ledger not written. Either prepare the input, or pass --allow-drop explicitly (and record the dropped keys in HISTORY).
guard.refuse_changed: this re-measure would **change %(count)d fact values** (unaccepted changes):
guard.accepted_boundary: accepted %(accepted)d via --accept-changes: %(keys)s — the rest still refused.
guard.refuse_changed_advice: ledger not written. Confirm each change is **measured, not guessed** (not missing input / not a broken instrument), then pass --accept-changes (or --accept-changes=k1,k2 per key).
guard.empty_ledger: no facts measured at all. An empty ledger is not a pass (zero-value guard).
